Great game, generated over a hundred million in revenue. However the devs don’t seem to be supporting the game very much.

The community poles are a cool idea and I like feeling heard. However it seems to be cheap pr.  Each update ads a single menial mechanic to the game. Took them something like 9 months to role out with the last one, With that amount of time they could have easily added drivers along with the drug addicted npcs that stand in their little square.

ATP the community supports the game more than the devs. Its in early access so I may be wrong for being extremely critical. But devs like concerned ape put on the impression that they cared while taking their time. No cheap pr was involved either.
The game had SO much potential, but updates are non existent, and its the same over and over again. Its a good game with a great premise, but dissapointing in the long run.

Your find sales point at different location to increase your sales.  You have competitors and must deal with them.  You have government rules that you must follow (police and curfew).  The game main topic is weird and gross, but it’s a perfect game to learn the ropes to become a successful business.  I recommend the creator to chose and make another new game, same mechanics, with a new topic that use any modern staples and offer it has a business teaching tool. :)
